section_intro: FORMATION is the layer where a record comes to be, and it contains the program's single row at status PROVED. Its two tiers share no evidence. The corner tier states, on DEF-A carriers, a channel criterion, two necessary conditions on a coupling and a formation rate; every result there is FORMAL or weaker, mathematics about the program's stipulated definition rather than a statement about the world. The world tier contains the two encoding-level rows C-71 and C-72. They no longer stand together: C-71 carries the sign law, guarded by the written surface's declared unwritten tolerance and scored as a within-part comparison against the same part's erased population; C-72 is PARTIAL after its ratio-one prediction proved to be an algebraic identity and the proposed replacement protocol was independently refuted. What remains on C-72 is the computed floor and the accumulate-versus-screen discriminator, while T-50 owes any runnable prediction. Both world-tier surfaces are MODELLED from literature-pinned classes and sealed pseudo-random patterns; no device was measured. The executable proof gate passes the claim blocks below, but it does not inspect this section prose, so every claim is repeated with rows, model, gate, grounding and scope in its own block. C-71's older EVIDENCE cell still describes one-mechanism FORMAL standing; its live PROVED status is enforced from the GROUNDED cell's two RECORDS VERIFIED entries.

claims.headline: a coupling opens a channel iff its code-space compression lies along the record
claims.prose: A coupling A opens a channel to a record R exactly when the compression P_g A P_g has a non-zero component along P_g R P_g; the model computes that component and returns the verdict. The earlier form of the criterion — that A fails to commute with the record's conjugate — is necessary and not sufficient: Zbar·Zbar2 anticommutes with the writer Xbar at ‖[A,Xbar]‖ = 32.0 and still opens no channel, giving chi = 0.00000000 against the live chi(Zbar) = 0.90811968 on the same carrier at the same lambda and t. The criterion was checked on the three venues of the T-9 battery and on 31 of 31 cycles of the incumbent, after failing its own fitted set. It is a statement about DEF-A carriers.
claims.gate_name: channel(Zbar, Zbar*Zbar2) does NOT -- the old form said it did

The row's own GROUNDED cell says validated, not proved. FORMAL: it is a theorem about the program's DEF-A carriers and by itself says nothing about any real record surface. The gate named here lives in model/validate_formation.py, which is neither of the two validators section 0.3 names; it is exercised by replicate/on_finding.sh step 4 as a whole-file pass over 17 checks, so the check does fire, but not inside the command sequence section 0.3 gives.

claims.headline: the copy is the divergence of the environment's conditional evolution
claims.prose: The coupling makes the environment's evolution conditional on the record's value, so the two values drive the bath to different states, and that divergence is the copy. Through the model, chi(record : environment) reaches 0.97527192 at t = 1.0 from exactly 0.00000000 at the t = 0 product state, that live t = 1.0 value standing as the positive control for the zero. The record's value never changes — [Zbar, H_tot] = 0 and its expectation is exactly constant — so what the environment acquires is a reading of a value the coupling did not set. The system cannot undo the copy because its own operators do not act on the environment. Both numbers are on the toric carrier alone; what the T-9 battery carried to the second, non-manifold venue is the qualitative check that chi is exactly 0 at t = 0 and positive at t = 4.
claims.grounding: model/validate_formation.txt (chi 0.97527192 at t = 1.0; 0.00000000 at t = 0, re-derived through the model, which execs the toric carrier); carrier LANE_F7_OCCUPANCY/f7_davies.py; LANE_T9_CARRIERINDEP/t9_sweep.txt (the qualitative pair on all three venues); LANE_T9_AUDIT/T9_carrier_audit.tsv line 98 (toric-2x2; bouquet)
claims.scope: FORMAL, about DEF-A carriers. The quoted magnitudes are toric-only: 0.97527192 and 0.00000000 come from model/validate_formation.py, which execs LANE_F7_OCCUPANCY/f7_davies.py; what carried to the second venue is the qualitative pair, chi exactly 0 at t = 0 and chi > 0 at t = 4. This block opens without the SINGLE-CARRIER prefix only because F-20 is TWO-CARRIER at audit line 98, where 'bouquet' is the audit's token for the non-manifold capped torus [[8,1,2]] and not the d=1 bouquet T-8 disqualified — and that is the same T-9 venue the audit refuses as a second carrier for G-16 and C-18, on the ground that its checks there are trivial endpoints the refuted criterion also passes, refusals that P-FORM-1 and P-FORM-5 quote. The mark is the audit's and is honoured here; the venue behind it is one this section declines elsewhere, and the second-carrier standing should be weighed on that. No absolute irreversibility is claimed: the closed dynamics stay unitary, and the row's own falsifier is an irreversibility in them. Nothing here transfers to a real record surface — the world-tier statements of this layer are C-71 and C-72 alone. The gate named here is in model/validate_formation.py, neither of the two validators section 0.3 names; it is run by replicate/on_finding.sh step 4.

claims.headline: weight at least d is necessary, and the weight-1 suppression is knill-laflamme
claims.prose: All 24 weight-1 couplings on the [[8,2,2]] toric carrier give |⟨Zbar⟩| ≤ 7.177e-15 at lambda = 0.8, against a noise floor of 1.550e-15 measured with no coupling at all and a live weight-2 value of 0.824573 as the positive control in the same run. The largest of the 24 sits at about 4.6x that floor, so what is measured is suppression by about fourteen orders against the live control, and this block does not call it a zero: a floor the reported number exceeds does not license the word (D-8). Four of the 24 break the writer symmetry with ‖[A,Xbar]‖ = 32.000, and the strongest of them, Y_4, still gives 5.317e-15. The suppression is Knill-Laflamme error correction and not a symmetry: weight below d stays unreachable whatever the coupling does to the writer. The mechanism is credited to Knill-Laflamme; the discriminating experiment is the program's.
claims.grounding: LANE_O11_MEANFORCE/o11b_weight1.txt (24 weight-1 couplings, noise floor 1.550e-15 for A = identity, argmax X_6 7.177e-15 and Y_4 5.317e-15, weight-2 control 0.824573); LANE_O11_MEANFORCE/o11_meanforce.txt ('system: toric code 2x2, dim 256')
claims.scope: SINGLE-CARRIER — every O-11 number is on one toric 2x2 [[8,2,2]] carrier at d = 2, where weight-1 and weight-d differ by a single site, so the weight threshold is exercised at its smallest possible separation. FORMAL, about DEF-A carriers. F-11 carries the same threshold at TWO-CARRIER (toric-2x2; steane-713), with threshold = d on six codes, and is deliberately not cited as a row here: the register's D-10 classes that six-code verification as an instrument check, because threshold = d is the definition of d and the check had no branch on which it could have come out otherwise, and F-11's own ITEM says it was tested at d = 2 only with the scaling claim not tested. The prefix on this block is the state of the evidence, and citing F-11's mark would have removed the prefix while adding no independent warrant. The word 'zero' was struck from this block's headline and prose for the reason the prose now gives; the numbers are unchanged. No validator re-derives them — model/validate_formation.py covers the neighbouring chi results on the same carrier, not the O-11 \|⟨Zbar⟩\| column — so the gate cell is none and the figures are read from the sealed lane. The row's falsifier is a weight-1 coupling that biases the record at any coupling strength.

claims.headline: weight d is not sufficient: the coupling must not commute with the writer
claims.prose: A weight-d coupling that commutes with the writer forms nothing. Zbar2, of weight 2 = d with ‖[Zbar2, Xbar]‖ = 0.000, gives |⟨Zbar⟩| = 0.000000 exactly, while Zbar, of the same weight with ‖[Zbar, Xbar]‖ = 32.000, gives 0.824573 on the identical carrier at the identical coupling strength: the exact counterexample and its positive control in one run. Formation therefore carries two requirements and neither alone suffices — weight at least d, and non-commutation with the writer. Necessity of weight at least d is the Knill-Laflamme half; the writer-non-commutation half is the program's own one-line symmetry theorem, F-8 reappearing at the level of H_tot, and the insufficiency counterexample is the program's. Nothing about equilibrium enters: an ordinary thermal environment at strong coupling supplies the rest, and the earlier non-equilibrium clause was an artefact of the weak-coupling Davies limit.
claims.grounding: LANE_O11_MEANFORCE/o11b_weight1.txt (Zbar2 exactly 0.000000 at ‖[A,Xbar]‖ = 0.000 vs Zbar 0.824573 at 32.000, same toric 2x2 carrier, lambda = 0.8); LANE_O11_MEANFORCE/o11_meanforce.txt ('system: toric code 2x2, dim 256'; symmetry control ⟨Zbar⟩ = 0)
claims.scope: SINGLE-CARRIER — the counterexample and its control are both on the one toric 2x2 carrier, and F-8, the symmetry theorem the writer-non-commutation half rests on, is instanced on that carrier alone. FORMAL, about DEF-A carriers. Ownership follows the ledger's own cells: F-15 is ASSEMBLED, with necessity of weight at least d credited to Knill-Laflamme and the insufficiency counterexample original; F-16 states flatly that the weight-1 suppression is Knill-Laflamme and not symmetry; F-8 is ORIGINAL. Cross-carrier support for the weight-at-least-d half is F-11, not cited here for the reason given in P-FORM-3. No validator re-derives these numbers, so the gate cell is none. The row's falsifier is a writer-commuting coupling that biases the record.

claims.headline: gauge invariance plus a locality bound below d forbids formation exactly
claims.prose: A coupling that is both gauge-invariant and local — the plaquette sum — gives chi = 0.00000000 exactly. Giving up gauge invariance while keeping locality gives 0.21703158, and keeping gauge invariance while giving up locality gives 0.90811968: two live positive controls beside the zero, from three calls to the same model function in the same run at the same lambda and t. Gauge-invariant operators of weight below d are trivial on the code space, 8 of 8 at weight 1, and at weight at least d they can be logicals. Formation requires that one of the two properties be given up.
claims.grounding: model/validate_formation.txt (plaquettes 0.00000000; sum Z_l 0.21703158; Zbar 0.90811968, all three re-derived through the model at lam = 0.8, t = 4.0); carrier LANE_F7_OCCUPANCY/f7_davies.py; LANE_T9_CARRIERINDEP/t9_sweep.txt

FORMAL, about DEF-A carriers; 'gauge invariance' here is the carrier's stabiliser gauge structure and is not a statement about any field theory. The two controls beside the zero are different configurations of the coupling, not the zero's own, as D-15 requires. The gate named here is in model/validate_formation.py, neither of the two validators section 0.3 names; it is run by replicate/on_finding.sh step 4. The row's falsifier is a gauge-invariant coupling of weight below d that forms a record.

claims.headline: records compose: forming one leaves the others untouched
claims.prose: Forming Zbar through a coupling that opens a channel to it gives chi(Zbar) = 0.90811968 while chi(Zbar2) = 0.00000000, with both record values moving by about 1e-16; the same holds with the two records exchanged. Through the model, every (coupling, target) pair in the family is reported independent, and the most the bath learns about a non-target member is 0.00000000 against the 0.90811968 live channel as the positive control. A coupling through the product Zbar·Zbar2 serves neither member: it forms a third logical.
claims.grounding: model/validate_formation.txt (all pairs independent; max cross-learning 0.00000000); REGISTER_V001.md:6961-6971 (the dependency structure and the two independence rows); LANE_T9_CARRIERINDEP/t9_sweep.txt (composition on toric [[8,2,2]] and [[4,2,2]] only)

FORMAL, about DEF-A carriers. The gate named here is in model/validate_formation.py, neither of the two validators section 0.3 names; it is run by replicate/on_finding.sh step 4. The row's falsifier is a coupling that forms one family member while disturbing another.

claims.headline: one local term forms nothing above noise; a sum of them forms at order lambda^2n*
claims.prose: A single local term produces nothing above float noise at any coupling strength in the sweep: 1.221e-15 at lambda = 0.020, about 1.4x the measured no-coupling floor of 8.882e-16 and the only one of the five points that exceeds it; 5.551e-17 at lambda = 0.050, below the floor; and exactly 0.000e+00 at 0.100, 0.200 and 0.400. The lane labels that column EXACTLY ZERO and this block declines the label, because a floor the reported maximum exceeds does not license it (D-8). The mechanism is that powers of one weight-1 operator are the identity or that operator and never reach the logical. A sum of local terms does form, with a log-log slope in lambda of 3.8988 against the predicted 2d = 4, and a weight-d coupling gives slope 1.9457 against a predicted 2 as the positive control in the same sweep. The exponent registered as lambda^2d is 2n*, and the factor of two is set by bath preparation, so the record-intrinsic quantity is the amplitude exponent, measured at 1.9987–1.9992. This sweep's own venue cannot make that discrimination: on the toric 2x2 carrier n* = d = 2, so 2n* and 2d are the same number and the slope 3.8988 does not separate them. The separation was measured elsewhere, on [[5,1,3]] with Z-only couplings, where the slope runs 9.4619 → 9.9966 → 10 = 2n* against 2d = 6, with a [[4,2,2]] control at 3.9854 → 4. The row stands at PARTIAL for exactly that reason, and the rate it names is connected to no physical number.
claims.grounding: LANE_PF5_LOCALBATH/pf5_localbath.txt (carrier dim 256, d = 2, 3-qubit bath, t = 4.0; the five-lambda single-local-term column 1.221e-15, 5.551e-17, 0, 0, 0; noise floor at lam = 0 of 8.882e-16; slopes 3.8988 and 1.9457); REGISTER_V001.md:6236 (the PF-5 table); REGISTER_V001.md:6321-6327 (F-25 withdrawn, the 2n* discrimination on [[5,1,3]] and the {X,Y,Z} can-fail check)
claims.scope: SINGLE-CARRIER — F-23 is not in the T-9 carrier audit and is therefore UNAUDITED, which is not a two-carrier mark; the sweep is on one toric 2x2 carrier at d = 2. The row is PARTIAL, and its own registered correction supersedes its headline exponent: 2n*, not 2d. Because n* = d on this carrier, the venue quoted here is blind to the distinction the headline turns on, and the correction is imported from the [[5,1,3]] run and not measured here — the same blindness the T-9 audit records against A-AL. The fitted slopes are fits on a small carrier. The 'exactly zero' claim previously made here was withdrawn on the arithmetic given in the prose; the lane's own label is quoted and declined rather than repeated. No validator re-derives these numbers; the gate cell is none. The row's falsifier is a single local term forming a record at any order.

claims.headline: the accumulation instrument, and the boundary between corner and world
claims.prose: Every world-tier statement of this layer passes through one instrument: given a per-record magnitude and a pattern of record values, the model returns the signed sum, the absolute sum, and the discriminator |Σ|/Σ|·|. The test for an accumulating quantity is whether it fails to cancel, and growth by itself decides nothing. C-46 states that test at a ratio of exactly 1; the erratum in P-FORM-9 shows that no occupancy surface carrying the model's own declared residual reaches exactly 1, and the discriminator survives in the weaker form that is all it ever needed — a ratio bounded below by a floor that does not fall with N makes |Σ| grow in proportion to N, while a ratio falling as N^(-1/2) makes |Σ| grow only as √N, which is screening. Nothing in that restatement requires the ratio to reach its ceiling, and that weaker form is the half of C-72 that survived refutation and now carries a check of its own in model/validate_geometry.py, quoted in P-FORM-12. The corner tier met the same three standards — extensive, additive, not a count — on a different quantity and a different carrier, in the bath-induced effective potential on the record register (C-47), and that is a separate FORMAL result on one carrier and not evidence for anything below. The corner results above are FORMAL mathematics about DEF-A carriers and carry no statement about a real record surface; the world-tier rows below are C-71 and C-72. The two tiers share no evidence and no carrier, and no number crosses between them.
claims.grounding: model/project_model.py:104-113 (the instrument), :193, :202 (the two world-tier entry points), :258-274 (the D-25 gate); model/validate_project.py:65-68 (the two instrument checks and the synthetic patterns they are fed); the superseded six-check erratum block formerly in model/validate_geometry.py (historical floor/discriminator figures); LANE_T50/GATE/c72_check_block.py (the live eight-check hardened S1–S6/B2/A2 block executed by validate_geometry.py); LANE_T34_NAND/t34_nand.txt; LANE_T32_REALSOURCE/t32_source.txt; LANE_SIGN_DEFINITE/sd1_signs.txt (the fail-to-cancel discriminator); LANE_ASYM_C_EXTENSIVITY/s5_master.txt and VERIFY/v4_surviving_candidate.txt with REGISTER_V001.md:8425-8460 (C-47's corner-tier extensivity, additivity and not-a-count, on CSS non-toric block registers)
claims.scope: The named gate feeds the instrument a synthetic all-ones pattern and a synthetic all-zeros pattern, so the '= 1' in its name is a property of that pattern and not a claim about any written page: over a one-signed vector the ratio is arithmetic and the check has no branch on which it could have come out otherwise (D-8). It confirms the instrument, not the world, and its companion null check feeds all-zeros — the same score-an-erased-cell-as-zero convention the erratum in P-FORM-9 corrects. It is kept as this block's gate because this block's claim is about the instrument. C-47 is FORMAL and SINGLE-CARRIER (steane-713) at the T-9 audit; that mark travels with the corner-tier sentence in this block even though the block's prefix is suppressed by C-71's TWO-CARRIER mark, and C-47's own ledger text frames its result as meeting a classical source standard, a framing this block does not adopt (D-1). Every world-tier number in this layer enters through .formation_occupancy and .formation_orientation, which reproduce the sealed lanes' seeds and draw order exactly (geometry.py:898, :924); the URM's D-25 provenance gate is enforced only inside URM.surface, on RecordSurface construction, and neither method calls it or touches PROVENANCE, so no provenance check fires on a single world-tier number in this layer. What those methods build is a modelled surface of a real mechanism, from constants pinned to literature classes and from seeded pseudo-random patterns; no instrument reading crosses this boundary. C-46 is a DEFINED row — a methodological discriminator that can be neither true nor false — and is not itself evidence for anything; restating its 'test for a gravity-role quantity' as a test for an accumulating quantity is the de-escalation D-1 requires and leaves the sentence close to a definition of its own terms.

claims.headline: the written nand page's ratio of one was an artifact; the floor that replaced it is confirmed and tight
claims.prose: ERRATUM, and it replaces this block's previous claim. The ratio |Σ|/Σ|·| = 1.000000 reported here for every written NAND page was an artifact of scoring an erased cell as exactly zero charge. A cell scored zero contributes nothing to either sum, so |−qS|/(qS) = 1 for any 0/1 page whatsoever: the figure was an algebraic identity with no branch on which it could have come out otherwise, and the sealed lane's own comment says so in terms — the ratio is 1 IDENTICALLY, and the draws beneath it are a consistency check of the premise, not independent evidence (LANE_T34_NAND/t34_nand.py:63-68). Two independent refuters reproduced that diagnosis rather than taking it; one swept every programmed count from 1 to 1000 on a 1000-cell page and found the minimum ratio still 1.0, so no data pattern anywhere can move it. Put the model's own over-erase residual on the erased cells of the model's own sealed pages — each erased cell carrying the ±5-electron draw the same seed-11 sequence already supplies — and over the 1000 sealed 1000-cell pages the ratio runs from 0.968134 at its minimum through 0.973846 in the mean to 0.979799 at its maximum, 997 distinct values, not one page at 1, with the programmed fraction f between 0.444 and 0.552. That spread is ONE residual realisation applied to 1000 pages and is not 1000 independent measurements; the gate named on this block draws a fresh residual per page and returns a different, lower minimum on the same sealed pages at the same N = 1000, 0.965292. Both numbers are reported because they are different statistics of the same thing. WHAT REPLACES THE IDENTITY IS A BOUND, AND THE BOUND SURVIVED REFUTATION. In signed electron units, with a programmed cell at −N_E, an erased cell at r_i of either sign with |r_i| ≤ Δ, and f the programmed fraction, worst-casing every erased cell at +Δ — which both opposes the injected sign and maximises the denominator — gives |Σ|/Σ|·| ≥ (N_E·f − Δ(1−f)) / (N_E·f + Δ(1−f)), valid for f > Δ/(N_E+Δ). At this surface's declared constants, N_E = 100 e and Δ = 5 e, that floor is 1.000000 at f = 1, 0.904762 at f = 0.5 and 0.882153 at f = 0.444, the leanest page in the sealed set; every one of the 1000 sealed pages clears its own floor at a minimum slack of 0.055355, and so does every page the shipped check draws, at every N it tests. THE BOUND IS TIGHT, NOT LOOSE, and that is the refuters' finding and not this block's earlier claim. One refuter minimised the ratio by brute force over the whole reachable (Σr, Σ|r|) polytope at eleven values of f and recovered the closed form to 1e-9, with the minimiser always at every residual pinned to +Δ; the other constructed that worst case directly at f = 0.5 and got 0.904761904762. Twenty thousand adversarial tolerance-edge pages produced zero violations, and one cell at Δ + 1e-9 breaks it — so the bound is exactly a restatement of 'no cell exceeds the declared tolerance', and the 0.055355 slack is an artifact of the model's mean-zero uniform residual rather than margin a physicist would have: bias the in-spec residual toward the physically correct over-erase sign and the slack falls to 0.0091 at a mean of 4.5 e and to exactly 0.000000 at 5 e. THREE PLACES THE BOUND DOES NOT REACH, all three established under refutation and all three part of the claim. It is VOID below f = Δ/(N_E+Δ) = 0.047619, where the closed form goes negative and the true minimum is zero and a nearly-erased page may screen arbitrarily. It holds only for a ZERO-MEAN residual, so Δ must be read as a spread about the erased mean and not as the erased mean's own distance from neutral: at an offset of 20 e the measured ratio is 0.665910 against a floor of 0.904548, and the surface's own arithmetic violates the bound. And it carries a single nominal N_E, so an actual programmed charge 5% below that nominal with an in-spec biased residual gives 0.900000 against a floor of 0.904762; stated correctly the numerator needs the minimum programmed-cell charge and the denominator the maximum. The floor contains no N — it is set by f and the tolerance ratio Δ/N_E alone — so it does not fall with page size, and that N-independence is what P-FORM-12's discriminator turns on. Control, same treatment and a different configuration: the all-programmed page has no erased cell for the residual to act on and its ratio is 1.000000000, the floor's f = 1 endpoint, so the treatment does not simply degrade everything it touches. What is one-signed is the injected charge, not the page: the write injects one carrier sign, that sign is open in design space — hole-trapping devices exist and fix the opposite one — and is settled once per device by the write, so pattern dependence of order Δ/N_E is now predicted and bounded rather than denied. The quantity is extensive at exactly 10 per decade, additive by charge superposition with the energy cross-term computed as a perimeter defect falling about 1/W from 0.04866 at W = 4 to 0.01475 at W = 32, and not a count: at fixed N = 1000 the charge moves 4.0x and the energy 4.0x across device generations. Standard device physics owns the programmed-page charge; the encoding-level statement is the program's, and so is this correction to it. WHAT DID NOT SURVIVE REFUTATION IS NOT THIS BOUND BUT THE MEASUREMENT PROTOCOL BUILT ON IT, and P-FORM-12 states exactly where that leaves the row.
claims.gate_name: C-72 S1 ACCUMULATION (widens successor): the written-vs-unwritten contrast's exponent excess clears the midpoint of the read's own null and doubled null
claims.grounding: the superseded six-check erratum run (historical: floor 0.904762; occupancy minima 0.965292/0.971562/0.972795; geometry 36 PASS at that snapshot); LANE_T50/GATE/c72_check_block.py (live eight-check hardened replacement) and model/validate_geometry.py (current 33 PASS, 0 FAIL); model/geometry.py:924-942 (occupancy_patterns: one seed-11 draw sequence supplying both the 1000 written 0/1 pages and the ±5 e over-erase field `unwritten_e`, and tol_e) with :893-894 (E_CHARGE and the declared N_E = 100 e); model/project_model.py:202-218 (formation_occupancy — :212 scores the written pages with erased cells at exactly zero, :215 scores the residual separately, the two models of the same cell that the erratum joins); LANE_T34_NAND/t34_nand.py:63-68 (the lane's own statement that the ratio is 1 IDENTICALLY and the draws are a consistency check of the premise, not independent evidence); LANE_T34_NAND/t34_nand.txt (sealed seed 11); model/geometry.py:895 and LANE_T34_NAND/t34_nand.py:40 (C_fg = 5e-18 F); ledger/status_ledger.tsv, C-72 GROUNDED (the registered outcome of the two refutations: the floor confirmed and tight, the protocol not); PROVENANCE "NAND floating gate" — charge-detrapping E_a ≈ 1.0 eV, JEDEC client EOL 1 yr at 30 °C (LANE_T41_EXTERNAL/CITATIONS.md #3)
claims.scope: The claim is at the encoding level and it is a BOUND, not an equality: occupancy encoding makes the injected charge one-signed on the programmed cells and bounds the opposing residual on the erased ones, so the accumulated ratio is bounded below and is pattern-dependent at order Δ/N_E. No device was measured. The page is modelled — 100 electrons per programmed gate, C_fg = 5.0e-18 F — with both its data patterns and its over-erase residual drawn from sealed seed 11, and the constants are pinned to literature classes, so what is scored is a modelled surface of a real mechanism; the census records that 100 e is the superseded planar figure and that a modern 3D part is tens of electrons. THE GATE NAMED HERE IS NEW AND THE CHECK THIS BLOCK USED TO DISCLAIM NO LONGER EXISTS: 'C-71 occupancy: written ratio == 1 for EVERY pattern' is gone from model/ entirely — it compared against a literal and had no failing branch (D-8) — and six erratum-era checks first stood in its place. T-50 later superseded them with the live eight-check S1–S6/B2/A2 block; the S1 contrast gate named here is current, while the raw-ratio outputs and mutation audit below are historical evidence from the superseded block. THE SUPERSEDED BLOCK'S D-8 STANDING WAS MIXED, AND IT IS PRESERVED RATHER THAN NARRATED AWAY. Under a two-signed-write mutation, run against the block's own code, this floor check, the discriminator and control B flip to FAIL while the widening check, control A and control C keep passing; and a refuter drew 200,000 adversarial pages from the gate's own residual domain and found zero violations of this check with the minimum margin attained and never crossed, which makes it a theorem about the generator — |r_i| ≤ Δ holds by construction — rather than a measurement. Those observations describe the superseded floor check. The live S1 gate instead tests the written-versus-unwritten contrast exponent against its own null and doubled-null midpoint, with the sealed T-50 mutation power recorded beside it. The erratum's rescope of C-71's and C-72's cells has landed in the ledger and this document moves no ledger cell; C-72 now stands at PARTIAL on it, blocked by T-50. claims.headline: the cocrpt remanent moment accumulates under dc saturation and screens on data
claims.prose: The field-free accumulated quantity of a written magnetic medium is the remanent moment M_r = M_s V Σ s_i in A·m². Under DC saturation |Σ|/Σ|·| = 1.000000 at N = 10, 100, 1000, 10000 and 100000 — and that figure carries the same defect the erratum found on the occupancy half, because the model writes DC saturation as N grains at exactly +1, for which the ratio is 1 by arithmetic and no draw could have returned anything else. Under a reversed-grain fraction ε the ratio is exactly 1 − 2ε on the model's declared encoding, and this block no longer says that this ratio IS the remanence squareness S = M_r/M_s a VSM reports: two independent refuters broke that identification, and it holds only in the collinear idealisation. The ratio is blind to easy-axis tilt, because |cos θ| = cos θ within ±90°, while squareness is not: at 30° of dispersion with zero grains reversed one refuter computes S = 0.872536 against a ratio of 0.999153, and at 20°, S = 0.940728 against 0.999997; the other computes Stoner-Wohlfarth remanence with fully random easy axes and gets S = 0.5000 in three dimensions and 0.6366 in plane with no grain reversed at all, cases in which the 1 − 2ε reading would report 25% and 18% of grains reversed in a medium in which none are. ε also has no operational definition anywhere in this record, and a reader handed a measured S can simply define ε := (1 − S)/2, which makes any falsifier written against that relation unable to fire. On data the quantity screens: the sealed seed-7 draw gives 0.400000 at N = 10 and 0.002700 at N = 1e5, and a DC-free coded pattern — which is what real drives write — screens exactly, to sum 0 and ratio 0. The solidity review's own draw at N = 1e5 gives 0.00096 where the sealed seed-7 instrument reproduced through the model returns 0.002700; nothing was measured in either, and the spread between two draws of one configuration is the single-draw variability this block's scope declares. The AC-erased control screens on the same instrument at 0.200000 at N = 10 and 0.002620 at N = 1e5, so this quantity does not distinguish a demagnetised medium from a real data track. A third control now ships beside the occupancy floor: under the identical ±Δ/N_E treatment the DC-saturated track still returns 1.000000 against a treated random-data ceiling of 0.091817, so what screens orientation's random page is the data and not the tolerance the treatment adds. Under DC saturation M_r is extensive at exactly 10 per decade and additive by superposition of moments; the lane's extensivity row is DC-saturated throughout, and on a data-bearing track — the case this same block insists on — no extensivity is measured at all. The energy cross-term is computed, holding from about 60 nm track separation at U_dd/E_b = 9.3333e-04 and failing at grain spacing, 2.0160e-01 at 10 nm. Standard device physics owns saturation remanence; the encoding-level statement is the program's.

claims.headline: the bar as it stands today: one proved row on the sign law, one partial row on the ratio
claims.prose: C-71 IS THE ONLY ROW IN THIS PROGRAM AT STATUS PROVED, and C-72, which stood beside it until this section's erratum, is now PARTIAL and blocked by T-50. Both are stated here on the terms the record carries today. QUANTITY, both rows: the accumulated per-record quantity of a formed surface — net trapped charge Σ Q_i in coulombs on a NAND page, remanent moment M_r = M_s V Σ s_i in A·m² on a magnetic track — and, for C-72, the dimensionless ratio ρ = |Σ q_i| / Σ|q_i| of it. WHAT C-71 PREDICTS IS A SIGN, NOT A MAGNITUDE AND NOT A RATIO: formation produces a nonzero extensive quantity absent from the unwritten surface, and its sign is fixed by the write mechanism and not by the data — negative on an electron-injection part, one-signed under DC saturation and about zero after AC erase on a magnetic one. THE PREDICTION CARRIES AN EXPLICIT GUARD, and the guard is what makes it a claim rather than a slogan: the sign holds for every page whose own |Σ Q| clears the surface's declared unwritten tolerance, and a page below that tolerance is read as unwritten and carries no sign claim at all. Under the model's own ±5 e over-erase residual the net-positive page fraction is 0.000 at f ≥ 0.01, and at f = 0.005 the page sum is −499 e, an order inside the declared 5000 e tolerance and therefore unwritten by the guard's own terms; on a 1000-cell page at 100 e per programmed cell that tolerance is fifty programmed cells, so the sign claim begins at about f = 0.05. WHY C-71 SURVIVED WHAT KILLED C-72's PREDICTION: the sign is read as the shift of the programmed population's V_t distribution against THE SAME PART's erased population, a within-part comparison that needs no absolute baseline and no datasheet constant. FALSIFIER, C-71: a programmed NAND page, clearing its own unwritten tolerance, whose net trapped charge carries the erase carrier's sign, or whose sign depends on the data pattern — a V_t-distribution shift readable on any flash tester; and a DC-saturated medium with no remanent moment above the AC-erased background, on a VSM. WHY C-72 IS PARTIAL. Its registered prediction, ρ = 1 for every data pattern on an occupancy-encoded surface, was an algebraic identity of scoring an erased cell as exactly zero, and under the model's own residual ρ is 0.968134 to 0.979799 across the sealed pages with none at 1 — which satisfies that row's own falsifier clause, so the row was falsified by its own model. The protocol proposed to replace it was then REFUTED by two independent refuters working with their own machinery, and it is NOT the corrected form: ρ is scale-free in C_fg, which cancels, but it is NOT translation-free, so it needs V_t,neutral to better than Δ — the very quantity being bounded. Mis-setting that reference by under five electrons, about 4.8% of the program window and roughly 0.19 V on a 4 V window, drives a good page below its own floor and fires the falsifier; setting it five electrons the other way returns ρ = 1.000000 exactly and restores the tautology the erratum exists to destroy. V_t,neutral is on no datasheet and NAND erase drives the gate past neutral by design, so no neutral cell exists on a finished part to calibrate against, while the proposed text explicitly forbade the one reference a V_t histogram does supply, the erased population's own median. Its falsifier clauses also fire on ordinary physics: a fixed-length record written into a growing page screens as N^-0.57 and trips the N^(-1/2) clause, which carries no fixed-f guard, and a 5% error in the nominal Q_p with an in-spec biased residual puts a perfectly good page below the floor. And it contradicts itself — one clause claims scope down to f = 0.0476 while another asserts a separation the floor only delivers above f = 0.0776. NO RUNNABLE PREDICTION FOR THE OCCUPANCY RATIO STANDS, and this document does not supply one; T-50 owes either a protocol whose reference a real V_t histogram supplies or a plain statement that the ratio has no runnable form. WHAT IS COMPUTED AND CONFIRMED is the floor and the accumulate-versus-screen discriminator. Six erratum-era checks first gated the raw-ratio form; T-50 superseded them with eight hardened S1–S6/B2/A2 gates. The live S4 gate named below scores the same distinction through a self-referenced contrast exponent, so the raw ratios that follow are retained as historical computed values and not described as the current validator topology. Through one function, at one declared tolerance and at matched N, occupancy's worst treated page reads 0.965292, 0.971562 and 0.972795 at N = 1000, 10000 and 100000, against orientation's best of two hundred treated random-data draws at 0.091817, 0.030901 and 0.008651: separations of 11x, 31x and 112x, and a separation that widens by a factor of 10.7 across two decades of N, which is what an N-independent floor against a ceiling falling like 1/√N gives. THE EARLIER 500x AND 484x FIGURES ARE WITHDRAWN: they paired a worst-of-many occupancy figure against a single sealed orientation draw of 0.002000 at N = 1000, about 0.08 of that draw's own expectation √(2/πN) = 0.025231, and that mismatch of statistics is what manufactured them. RECORDS VERIFIED: NAND floating-gate page, occupancy-encoded trapped charge; DC-saturated CoCrPt track, orientation-encoded remanent moment — two structurally different write mechanisms, carrier injection and field direction, and not two parameter sets of one model.
